hook: Democrats flipped Texas. And 6 more seats
caption:
🗳️ Democrats won control of the House and Senate, flipping 7 Senate seats. From next year, new laws need their votes.
🛢️ Iran says 2 tankers and a tugboat caught fire in Hormuz; Trump says the war was worth it.
📉 Dow up 1,569 points, but Asian chip stocks sank. Holding tech funds? Expect swings.
✈️ New bomb threats hit European flights; none proved real. Flying soon? Check your flight status.
🏛️ Abdul El-Sayed will be the first Muslim elected to the US Senate.
Which story surprised you most?
Follow @you.didnot.know for the daily brief.
